description: Projections converted from Fraunhofer EZRT .raw files: the original 2048-byte header of every projection, so a conversion back to EZRT is lossless, and how the detector was read (reco.json).

acquisition.description: Node path of the ct_acquisition built from the headers.

headers.description: One row per projection, in the order of the acquisition's projections; time = the projection's time.

header.description: EZRT header as stored in the file.
